annotation.unknown_reason: The supplied interface has no operation to expand a variable-length array into one endpoint per selected user. The number of users absent from the least-message channel is three, but the fixed scaffold provides exactly three membership obligations and cannot establish their identities through the permitted source operations without selecting individual array elements; doing so would not be justified by the source-derived selection workflow.
